Scene:
A childhood city becomes a threshold in memory. Ibn Arabi teaches that departure can reveal what staying had hidden. The first witnesses argue over what deserves to be written at all. Your task is not to solve the saint, but to decide which trace of the meeting will survive in students, officials, and ordinary witnesses.

- opt_page_0000_3: Ask The Meccan Host what the witness will cost.
